description: Intl.PluralRules and Intl.DisplayNames as the Translations Editor uses them (M6): the cardinal and ordinal plural categories and selections of target locales computed at run time (en, de-AT, pl, ar, pt-PT, pt-BR, fr-CA, zh-Hant-TW, cy, sr-Latn, the alias iw, tlh without plural data, which takes the default locale's rules, and the malformed en_US, whose RangeError the program catches), options chosen by a condition, language names of those tags in the UI locales en, de, fr-FR and en-GB (dialect names, compositions, codes as fallback), an ordinal suffix constant, region, script, standard language and currency names with fallbacks, and an undefined locale taking the default; in Svelte, React and Vue
